titolo: Anthropic researcher claims Claude proved the Riemann hypothesis
descr: Levent Alpöge announced a Claude‑generated proof of the Riemann hypothesis, but it remains unverified and pending formal review.
paragrafi: On November 20, 2026, Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge posted a four‑page statement on his personal website claiming to have proved the Riemann hypothesis with the help of Claude.
Anthropic had floated on the Nasdaq a day earlier, raising over $93 billion in its public offering, but the company has not issued an official comment on Alpöge’s announcement.
The Riemann hypothesis, first proposed in 1859, is one of seven Millennium Prize problems and underlies many results in number theory and the distribution of prime numbers.
perche: If the proof holds, it would demonstrate that large language models can assist in solving deep mathematical problems, a capability far beyond current free or locally hosted models. Until the proof is independently validated, researchers and developers should treat the claim as a promising experiment rather than a confirmed breakthrough.
